rationale: The bid-ask spread of 245 bps is extremely wide, making any entry immediately disadvantaged by roughly 2.5% before any move occurs. While relative volume is elevated at 13x and the gap is meaningful, the absence of news context, no candle data, missing 20-EMA, and an illiquid float of 8.77M shares with no short interest data provide insufficient mechanical edge to justify a directional bet. The spread alone would consume most of a reasonable intraday profit target, making risk/reward unfavorable in either direction.
